notes.title: A Rat's Life demo OUT NOW !
notes.content:
The demo for[b] Pieces Games[/b]’ debut project  [b][i]A Rat’s Life : The Cat Conspiracy[/i][/b], a first-person rat adventure, is now live on Steam. 

It features exclusive achievements and around 1:30 to 3 hours of playtime.

We're only two persons working on this project, and players' comments help us a lot. Feel free to complete this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc0SL8rJO2vxdlZLLpMz1eoZ9Pc-Cyi7Sf7xjxCvYotlE36ww/viewform]survey[/url] after your playthrough. 

[previewyoutube=rtDSIRuMfBs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What to expect: [/b]
[list]
[*] First-person rat action : run on four paws, travel through pipes, talk to your neighbors, climb walls, MOVE LIKE A RAT ;
[*] Detect odors and dig through walls to gather yum, dirt and maybe even cheese (or just destroy the walls because you're a vermin and destroying walls is what you do) ; 
[*] Buy props and equip your rat to access new areas ;
[*] Sneak around the Third Wall Cheese District, a borough populated by friends and shady characters.
[/list]
